text:
deploy-bot: starting staggered rollout for pricing-service. pinned canary image `pricing:2026-08-01-2100`. feature flag `price_model_v2` being toggled with geo-split: US=0.6%, CA=0.2%, UK=0.2% (aggregate 1%). quiet window 22:00-02:00 UTC. posting plan + runbook snippets.

ana: ack. ramp plan: 1% aggregate -> 5% -> 20%; hold times 10m / 15m / 30m. critical thresholds: p95>300ms OR 5xx>0.3% OR pricing-delta > 1.5% (abs) => hold/rollback.

chris: pinning note added to release ticket. prefer country-split so we can cut out only affected locales if needed. also enable sticky cohort 25m.

ops-lead: infra ok. reserving nodepool `pricing-canary-us` and `pricing-canary-eu`. oncall ready. if rollback required, prefer targeted country removal before full drain.

deploy-bot: ff commands (supports region weights):
```
/ff set price_model_v2 --region-split US=0.6,CA=0.2,UK=0.2 --cohort canary
/ff set price_model_v2 --percent 5
/ff set price_model_v2 --percent 20
/ff set price_model_v2 --region-remove UK   # remove UK from rollout
/ff set price_model_v2 --percent 0  # full drain
```

telemetry-bot: temp dashboard live: `price.latency.p95`, `price.5xx_rate`, `price.delta_pct`. alerts: p95>300ms OR 5xx>0.3% OR delta>1.5% over 5m => page.

qa: smoke tests queued against canary pods. will post any failures.

deploy-bot: initial canary applied (US=0.6,CA=0.2,UK=0.2). checkpoint in 10m.

telemetry-bot: 10m checkpoint: US p95=160ms, CA p95=170ms, UK p95=290ms, global 5xx=0.08%, price.delta_pct: US=0.6%, CA=0.7%, UK=1.8% :warning: UK delta crossed threshold.

ana: seeing UK delta 1.8% (above 1.5%). recommend removing UK from rollout and pause overall ramp until we analyze.

chris: agree. remove UK weight to reduce blast radius. executing: `/ff set price_model_v2 --region-remove UK`

deploy-bot: executed region-remove UK. new split US=0.6,CA=0.2. holding for analysis.

telemetry-bot: post-change checkpoint (3m): US p95=165ms, CA p95=172ms, 5xx=0.09%, price.delta_pct: US=0.6%, CA=0.7% -> OK. no paging.

ops-lead: investigating UK logs/latency. early note: third-party price lookup in UK region had intermittent 504s at +4m; suggest backend retry tuning.

qa: replayed failing flows against canary pods; reproduced a small ranking jitter tied to a specific SKU type in UK. filing bug to model team.

release-eng: updating release notes with canary observation: "UK experiments showed a >1.5% pricing delta for long-tail SKU flows. UK removed from initial rollout; further analysis ongoing." Adding mitigation blurb.

ana: decision: hold ramp. do not proceed to 5% until model team confirms fix or we re-run a UK-only canary. ops to monitor autoscaler and call out if any further 5xx.

chris: if we later need to fully undo exposure, plan is to run `/ff set price_model_v2 --percent 0` which is faster and preserves canary image pinned for postmortem.

ops-lead: will keep nodepools cordoned and ready. oncall will run the rollback playbook if paging triggers.

telemetry-bot: 30m follow-up: trend stable for US/CA; UK metrics back to baseline after region removal. no alerts fired.

deploy-bot: summarizing: canary applied -> UK exceeded price delta threshold -> region removed -> hold ramp. actions: (1) model team to investigate UK long-tail SKU delta, (2) ops to tune third-party timeouts in UK, (3) release-eng to append canary note in release.

release-eng: added final summary and assigned owners. will keep the release ticket open until we either resume ramp or fully drain.

ana: thanks all. we'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00 UTC to decide next steps. if model fix is quick, we may re-run UK micro-canary at 0.2% before resuming global ramp. :eyes:
